exposure: Antimicrobial prophylaxis regimen (erythromycin vs. amoxicillin and azithromycin)
outcome: Group B Streptococcus or E. coli carriage
cohort: 156 pregnant women with preterm premature rupture of the membranes
finding: Women prescribed amoxicillin and azithromycin for preterm premature rupture of the membranes had a longer latency to delivery compared to those prescribed erythromycin.
mod_finding: There was no difference in the mode of delivery between the two groups.
